documentation:
The embedded view displayed on the 2nd pane of the MaterialConfig carousel. Allows users to map columns in their uploaded file to Elev8 material attributes

Input Data:
-params.fileDate: the data of the uploaded file
-params.fileName: the name of the uploaded file

Output Data:
-sends a message to the attributeSelection message handler: located on the root of the MaterialConfig view, sends from the custom.data binding

Custom Properties:
-custom.config.options: returns the headers of the uploaded file to be used in the dropdowns
-custom.data.inputErrors: a dict of all the attirbutes and if there is an error in the selection made or not (e.g., duplicate entry or data type error)
-custom.data.selections.columns: the selected column for each attribute
-custom.data.selections.datetimeFormats: the selected datetime format for each datetime attribute
